newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X stock falls after report.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X stock falls after report.

text.p: Shares of Bre-X Minerals Ltd fell sharply in heavy volume on Friday after a trading halt was lifted.

Bre-X, operator of the massive Busang gold property in Indonesia, was halted to allow the company to explain its position after a Canadian newspaper reported it hit snags with with an Indonesian partner and the country's government.
Bre-X shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange were down C$2.65 to C$24.25, amid new uncertainty over Bre-X's ability to develop its huge gold find. Its Nasdaq-listed shares were off 1-24/32 to 17-31/32.

The company, responding to a story Friday in the Toronto Globe and Mail, said an Indonesian legal adviser told it that claims of one of its Indonesian partners to a 10 percent participation in Busang's rich southeast and northwest zones were without merit.

The partner, PT Krueng Gasui, has a 10 percent stake in Busang I, known as the central zone, and claims it is entitled to a similar stake in Busang II and Busang III, the southeast and northwest zones.
